articles.title: RB Martin, former All-Pro with Bucs, dies at 36
articles.summary: Doug Martin, a former Boise State star who went on to be an All-Pro running back for the Buccaneers, has died, his family said in a statement Sunday. He was 36.

articles.title: McDaniel: Focus remains on 1-6 Dolphins, not job
articles.summary: Dolphins coach Mike McDaniel said he isn't thinking about his job security, even after a 31-6 loss Sunday to the Browns dropped his team to 1-6.

articles.title: Jets not ready to name QB1 after Fields benching
articles.summary: After a dismal first half Sunday, Justin Fields was replaced by backup Tyrod Taylor on the Jets' first offensive drive after halftime with New York trailing the Panthers 13-3.

articles.title: Vikes' Hockenson livid after replay overturns TD
articles.summary: T.J. Hockenson was livid Sunday when NFL replay overturned a fourth-quarter touchdown catch that would have closed the Philadelphia Eagles' lead to two points in the Vikings' eventual 28-22 loss.

articles.title: Panthers QB Young hurts ankle, iffy for Week 8
articles.summary: Panthers quarterback Bryce Young was ruled out for the rest of the game after suffering an ankle injury late in the third quarter of Sunday's game against the Jets.

articles.title: Maye's 91 completion pct. tops Brady's Pats mark
articles.summary: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye was 21-of-23 passing for 222 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions Sunday at Tennessee -- breaking Tom Brady's franchise record for highest completion percentage in a game.

articles.title: McCoy, Miller injured as Saints lose, fall to 1-6
articles.summary: New Orleans Saints coach Kellen Moore told reporters that "there's concern" regarding Pro Bowl center Erik McCoy as well as running back Kendre Miller, both of whom left Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Chicago Bears at Soldier Field with injuries.

articles.title: Coen: Blame for Jags' drubbing 'starts with me'
